name: Sabbath and rest
summary: Keep a weekly day of rest with a prep checklist the day before and a rest-day plan that fits you.

onboarding.prompt: What does rest mean to you?
onboarding.reaction: Lovely. The rest-day plan will fit that.

onboarding.prompt: What usually gets in the way?
Tap a prep time the day before.

plan_blueprint.calendar: A prep reminder the day before and the rest day blocked on your calendar.

approach_variants.habit: Same prep routine every week; streak.
approach_variants.willpower: Challenge: a fully screen-free rest day once a month.
approach_variants.time: Rest day blocked out; work kept off the calendar.
approach_variants.reward: Owner-chosen treat for the rest day itself.
approach_variants.resource: Prep week gathers meals, errands and supplies ahead.

guardrails: Every plan item can be edited, moved or removed, and you can add your own steps.
restart_rules: A missed rest day isn't made up; next week's prep reminder comes a little earlier.
